title: After the Mile Championship: High-Key Happy

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser has a great race and beats Daitaku Helios! Afterward, the two promise to race each other again one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship comes to a close with an unexpected invitation…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios invites Matikanetannhauser to her post-loss pick-me-up party.
